title: Software Development Manager
jobDescription:
Who we are? Kaleidofin is a fintech platform building a digital ecosystem to ensure finance for everyone, everywhere. We provide financial solutions for low-income customers and informal economy businesses through our ki credit Platform, which combines credit health assessment (ki score), middleware rails integration, advanced risk management dashboards (ki view), and debt capital markets structuring capabilities (ki credit). Our platform enables financial institutions to serve customers better through innovative solutions, including structured finance approaches (securitization, portfolio sales, co-lending), tailored funding for women entrepreneurs, agricultural workers, farmers and MSMEs, and local currency funding mobilization for new asset classes. Currently impacting over 6 million customers across India, Bangladesh, and Kenya, Kaleidofin' s risk infrastructure—including our credit scoring and dashboards—is used by multiple inclusive finance institutions in emerging markets where most customers work in the informal sector. To date, we've facilitated over $3 billion in debt capital to underserved communities. Over the years, Kaleidofin has raised equity of over USD 40 million from marquee investors, including Rabo Partnerships, IDH Farmfit Fund, the Gates Foundation, Oiko Credit, Flourish, Omidyar Network, Blume Ventures, Bharat Fund and Dell Foundation who share our commitment to financial inclusion and impact. Kaleidofin has received exceptional international recognition in being featured as one of only six Indian companies on the Forbes 100 To Watch in Asia list and in being selected to present at the United Nations General Assembly Special Task Force. Kaleidofin won the Swanari Tech Sprint 2023 organized by the RBI Innovation Hub and emerged as a winner at the prestigious G20 Tech Sprint 2024: Technology for the Planet, organized by the Bank of International Settlements. We also invest in culture and team growth, reflective in our selection as a Great Place to Work for multiple years ‍ To know more about Kaleidofin, do visit our site https://kaleidofin.com What you'll do? As a Software Development Manager, you will be responsible for shaping product features and driving the technical execution of the product roadmap. You will work closely with your team to build systems that stress scalability, accuracy, and robustness. This is a hands-on leadership role – you will actively participate in design, architecture reviews, code reviews, troubleshooting, and work alongside engineers to solve problems. Your team will be presented with ample opportunities to tackle complex business problems and create real impact for our customers and partners. ‍ ‍Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
· Own the engineering roadmap, architecture, scalability, and quality of products. · Actively contribute to design discussions, architecture reviews, and coding standards; step in with hands-on support when needed. · Collaborate with Product Managers and the Business team to define long-term product strategy and release planning in a fast-paced environment. · Guide your team through complex technical challenges in fintech and lending tech domains, including AI/ML-driven credit scoring. · Mentor and coach engineers across levels; foster strong technical decision-making, code quality, and delivery discipline. · Establish, enforce, and evolve engineering best practices. · Drive adoption of modern data engineering practices: big data processing, Py Spark, No SQL/unstructured data, and scalabledata pipelines. · Balance short-term delivery with long-term architecture sustainability. · Foster a culture of ownership, innovation, and continuous improvement. · Define and implement learning and development plans, invest in team members' career growth, and create succession pipelines. ‍ Who you need to be? · 8+ years of experience in end-to-end cloud software development with exposure to scalable, fault-tolerant, and secure distributed systems. At least 1–2 years managing engineering teams. · Bachelor's or Master's degree in engineering (preferably Computer Science or related fields) from a reputed institute (IITs, NITs, or equivalent top schools preferred). · Strong CS fundamentals, algorithms, and excellent problem-solving skills. · Hands-on experience in system design(both high-level and low-level) with the ability to validate and improve solutions. · Familiarity with AI/ML model integration, particularly in fintech, lending tech, or credit scoring, is a strong advantage. Basic knowledge of statistical analysis, mathematical modelling and machine learning. · Deep expertise in Python and/or Java and related stack (Spring Boot), microservice-based architecture, and building maintainable, unit-tested code · Proficiency in databases (SQL & No SQL), message queues (Kafka), and data engineering stacks(Big Data, Py Spark, unstructured databases). · Very comfortable with data lakes, warehouses, and ETL/ELT paradigms. Familiarity with Spark, Cassandra, AWS data pipeline stack(Athena, S3, Glue data catalogue.), Airflow, etc. · Experience with CI/CD pipelines, Dev Ops, and infrastructure tooling (Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, ELK, Prometheus, Grafana, etc.). · Knowledge of web technologies (JS, HTML5, CSS), UI patterns (MVC, MVVM, MVP), and exposure to Android development is a plus. · Comfortable operating in high-growth startup environments; thrives in ambiguity and drives clarity. · Must be comfortable working in fast-paced agile environments. Ability to plan, prioritise, estimate and execute releases with a strong degree of predictability. · Excellent leadership and people management skills with proven ability to develop and grow teams. · Prior experience in fintech, e-commerce, or product development is highly desirable. · Experience with AWS stack preferred. · Be comfortable with a mix of hands-on development and people management. Ability to propose and validate system design
- low-level and high-level both. Enjoy jamming on code refactoring, architecture and design principles. · Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate across technical and business stakeholders. If you fit the bill, write to us at careers@kaleidofin.com Job location Bangalore
